# Ghostex 11.6.1
## 11.6.1 - 2026-11-13
**Ghostex 11.6.1 is out.** Codex on Windows recovers when it quits, model lists read live from each agent, a coordinator on any agent with a clearer setup, fewer coordinator notifications, a limit card that can continue on Opus, folded sent answers, and many fixes, on the computer and the Android app.
### 🤖 Agents and models
- **Codex recovers when it quits early:** a Codex that quits before its first message shows "Codex isn't running" with Restart, and a message you send then restarts it and goes through. ([#595](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/595)) - **Model lists come from each agent:** the model menu for Claude Code, Cursor and Antigravity now matches what the agent itself offers, read from its own model picker, with older versions under Legacy models (GPT-5.6 Terra, Opus 5 and Sonnet 5 are back there), and Antigravity lists Gemini 4 Carbon. - **Amp picks its model in Amp:** Amp's model pill says "Pick the model in Amp" and opens Terminal view. - **Gemini CLI is no longer supported:** it leaves Settings > Agents, the New session menu, setup and the Agents Hub. Antigravity CLI runs Google's Gemini models.
### 🔐 Accounts and limits
- **The limit card says why it didn't switch and can continue on Opus:** when no account has room, the card names the model ("No account has room for Fable 5.2"), says in one sentence why each other account is out and when it continues, and offers to continue on another model with room ("Continue with Opus 5.5 on ST"). A Fable session that runs out on every account continues on Opus by itself; turn that off with Settings > Accounts > Claude rules > Continue on Opus when Fable runs out. On the computer and the phone. - **Usage shows right after a reset is used:** the usage popup, sidebar meters and Settings > Accounts show a Claude account's new limits at once, and clicking "Updated … ago" in a Claude or Codex usage popup reads that account again (Refresh now).
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **Pick a coordinator's agent after the form:** New Coordinator no longer asks for agent, model and effort; Next opens the agent picker, "Pick the coordinator's agent", with every agent you have, on the computer and the phone. Any agent can now run a coordinator. - **A coordinator on a weaker setup says so:** a coordinator on a model or effort that may make it work worse shows an amber "Coordinator quality may be degraded" pill with why and Hide for this chat, and tells you once. A coordinator that drifts from its playbook is reminded in its next message. - **Coordinators notify you only for what needs you:** a coordinator finishing a turn no longer notifies; only a turn that adds a question, a Needs you item or a Blocked item does. - **Codex's own reviewer is no longer an approval for you:** an approval Codex's reviewer decides no longer shows as your approval card, and the Approvals pill is red while a thread's approval waits on you. ([#597](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/597)) - **Workers shows each thread's work items:** a second line of item pills (two, then +N), with a hover card for the item's status, steps and asks and the thread's last report; a click shows the item in the Work panel. - **Idle threads are left alone:** a thread that ended its turn with a background shell still running counts as idle, so it no longer gets "no new output" nudges or stall reports. - **The How to use note reads in two short lines** under its pill.
### 💬 Chat
- **Your sent answers fold to one line:** the page's or form's name, "3 answered · 1 skipped" and a button that opens the page again; opened, each question shows once by its tag with its answer and note. On the computer and the phone. - **Select text to reply:** selecting text in the conversation shows a small bar with Copy, Add to Chat and Reply. - **Up recalls your sent messages:** Up in the chat box steps back through this chat's sent messages like a shell history, and never fails with "The agent already took this message". - **Pictures and files move with a paste across computers:** a picture or file pill pasted into a chat on another computer gets its file copied there, so the agent can open it. - **A "could not deliver" notice reaches a busy agent** as soon as its input box is ready, instead of waiting for a turn end that may never come. - **The ? pill no longer opens an empty popup** for a question a work item also asks.
### 🛡️ Autopilot
- **Autopilot answers approval cards by default:** Answer approval cards is on when Autopilot is on (a choice you made stays), and Autopilot never approves anything for a read-only thread.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Drag another computer's sessions in the sidebar** between Pinned, Sessions and Parked, and reorder them among the pinned ones. - **Popovers open at their full height** and fade in, instead of opening small and growing. - **Every drag shows the same see-through ghost** as a dragged sidebar session. - **Settings is quieter:** section subtitles that repeated what the switches say are cut or shortened. - **The Grok logo is as large as Claude's** in the chat header, sidebar, pickers and Settings. - **A tool call card opened inside a Quiet View card fills its width,** without the line beside its rows. On the computer and the phone. - **The Beads view's Tree and Board read the same project,** a narrow panel fits a new bead, the search and links, the divider width is kept, links show whole on hover, and failed syncs are logged (#599), thanks to @sebastianarena. - **An iPhone keeps a busy computer's connection** instead of reconnecting about every minute, a busy computer says what Reset connection does, and the phone's kept logs scrub names as they are written (#596, ghostex-mobile #39), thanks to @sebastianarena.

# Ghostex 11.6.0
## 11.6.0 - 2026-11-13
**Ghostex 11.6.0 is out.** Quiet View for every chat and a new Summary view, Session details in Overview and Limits tabs, Ghostex pages you can export and answer anywhere, Snooze for pages and forms, a voice agent that waits for "reply", calmer dictation that opens Hex by itself, accounts of your other computers managed from here, agents that run without Ghostex's hooks, read-only threads for coordinators, long messages that always arrive, Claude on Windows PowerShell 5.1, and a lighter phone app.
### 👁️ Chat views
- **Quiet View is on for every chat:** every chat now reads as the conversation, with the work between two replies folded into one line, and the newest turn opens by itself. An opened line's header says what it holds ("Working", "Worked for 2m 5s", "Previous turn") instead of its counts. Settings > Chat > Advanced still turns it off. On the computer and the phone. - **Summary view shows your messages and the newest reply:** earlier replies and reports sit behind one "N earlier replies · N reports" line, only pages, charts and questions still waiting on you stay in full, and work that comes after a reply in the same turn (a thread's report, a background task) shows under Active work instead of hiding until the turn ends. On the computer and the phone. - **Detailed view is Quiet View with every line open,** so switching views only opens or shuts lines and nothing jumps. - **Agent work Reduced and Quiet, and the Tool call cards preview, are retired:** Quiet View replaces them, and anyone who used one of them starts in Quiet View.
### 📄 Pages and forms
- **Export a Ghostex page and get its answers back:** any page downloads as one HTML file that works in any browser, where its Send becomes Export answers (JSON to copy or download). Drop or paste that JSON into a chat, or use Import answers, and it reaches the agent as the page's own answers. On the computer and the phone. - **Snooze for pages and forms:** a form card and the page window get Snooze, with 1 hour, 6 hours and 24 hours, which puts the form off For later until then. On the computer and the phone. - **The page window has a ⋯ menu:** Snooze, Export page, Import answers and Open in browser sit under one ⋯ beside Hide and Close, in a light glass that reads over the page. - **Popups stay open when you switch apps:** Settings, the page window and the chat's form popup no longer close when you go to another app, so you can paste from a clipboard app. - **A form popup fades out once its answers are sent,** and stays open on them when the send fails; the page window fades out the same way. - **Reply and Mention for forms and pages in the work list:** a form's or page's row has Reply beside Open, whose words go to the agent tagged with the questions it still asks, and Mention in chat box in its ⋯ menu. A question form's row is marked with a pink checklist. On the computer and the phone. - **Copy as Markdown from the work list:** a row's ⋯ menu (now also on a right-click of its title) copies a question with its details and answers, or a form with each question, as Markdown. - **A Ghostex page no longer shrinks for a moment after it opens:** about a second after an answered or new page opened, it was drawn at about two thirds of its size in the window's corner and then grew back.
### 🧾 Session details
- **Session details has Overview and Limits tabs:** Overview holds Environment (with the agent's version), Changes, Context with Compact context under it, Tasks, Connectors, Skills, Memory files, Background tasks and the agent's other settings; Limits holds your plan limits with their reset times, Cost and time, and Cache. On the computer, in the browser and on the phone. - **The Context card shows its usage when folded:** it opens folded with its usage line and bar under its title, and unfolds for the breakdown; a card with nothing more to show has no fold. - **The status line under the phone's chat box follows the computer:** it shows the pins you saved for each agent in the Ghostex app on the chat's computer, and Context details says so.
### 🎙️ Voice and dictation
- **The voice agent waits until you say "reply":** with Settings > Voice Agent > Answer when I say "reply" (on by default for Regular calls), the agent answers a spoken turn only once it ends with "reply", "over" or "go ahead", so a pause to think no longer gets an answer. On the computer and the phone. - **Dictation opens Hex by itself:** on a Mac, dictating while Hex is closed opens it in the background and transcribes once it is ready, instead of failing. - **A live waveform while you dictate:** the recording pill shows your voice as it records, with ✕ to cancel on the left (the microphone's Stop finishes), and says "Can't hear you" after 3 seconds of near-silence. While dictation can't transcribe yet, the microphone is greyed and says why. On the computer and the phone. - **Calm dictation cards:** a problem shows in a small Dictate card that says what to do, and your recording is always safe in Past recordings. A refused microphone, no words heard and nothing waiting are cards too, not toasts. On the computer and the phone. - **Dictated words go where you were typing:** they replace the selection, or go in at the caret, that the chat box or question form box had when you started recording, even if you clicked elsewhere meanwhile. On the computer and the phone.
### 🔐 Accounts and privacy
- **Manage another computer's accounts from here:** Settings > Accounts has a computer picker that shows a connected computer's saved Claude and Codex accounts and usage. Adding or reconnecting one signs in on that computer while the sign-in page opens on yours, and a remote session's Reconnect opens Accounts on its computer. On the computer and the phone. - **A Claude login waiting to renew stays ready:** it no longer says "The saved login expired. Reconnect this account." while its access token is only due for renewal. - **Turn usage analytics off with a launch option:** start Ghostex or its server with `--no-analytics`, or set `GHOSTEX_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1` or `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`, and no usage analytics are sent; setup no longer points to a Settings switch that did not exist, thanks to @lardissone for raising it. - **Reset all settings asks first:** one click on Reset all settings to defaults in Settings > About no longer puts every setting and the app icon back with no way back, and a key typed while a Settings confirmation is open stays in it (#589), thanks to @lardissone.
### 🤖 Agents
- **Claude, Codex and OpenCode run without Ghostex's hooks:** Ghostex follows them from their own files on every computer and removes only the hooks it had installed. If an agent goes unseen for 90 seconds, Ghostex installs its hook for that session and says so in the chat; Settings > Agents > Use agent hooks brings the hooks back for good. Without hooks, a Claude question with several questions shows them all in the chat card. - **Agents install the way their makers say:** first-run setup, Settings > Agents and Install buttons use each agent's official installer (its own install script, PowerShell on Windows, or npm, Homebrew or WinGet where that is how it ships) instead of mise, unless mise already manages it. DeepSeek Harness installs with npm, Pi with its own installer, Claude Code on Windows without Git for Windows, and OpenCode's Homebrew choice installs OpenCode 2. - **Antigravity's Update says it updates itself,** in Settings > Agents and the Updates list, instead of running an installer that does nothing.
### 🧭 Coordinators
- **Read-only threads:** `ghostex coordinator start-thread --read-only` starts a thread that can look but not change anything (Claude in Plan mode, Codex in its read-only sandbox), and it stays read-only across restarts and wakes. ([#554](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/554)) - **Coordinators read their playbook once:** the playbook ships in Ghostex, and `ghostex coordinator guide --changes` shows a coordinator only what changed since it last read it (#580), thanks to @lardissone. - **Playbook overrides have room to grow:** an override can be up to 100,000 characters (was 20,000), and past 20,000 every save says how long it is. ([#584](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/584)) - **The work list reads evenly and moves smoothly:** every text in it is one size, an opened row eases open and shut, scrolls just enough to show its answers when the list is full, and shows its threads as their agents' logos beside the answers. - **Coordinators mark their replies again by default:** Marked handovers is now one setting with three choices, Off, Coordinators only (the default) and Every session, so coordinators answer in marked sections without you changing anything; threads always mark their reports. Anyone who had it on for every session keeps Every session.
### 💬 Chat
- **Long messages always arrive:** a message over 256 KB (a pasted crash report, for example) now reaches the agent in pieces instead of failing with "The agent's terminal didn't take your message". - **A held message no longer holds up the queue:** a message Ghostex held for a moment goes out as soon as a working agent's input box is ready, instead of waiting for its whole turn. ([#591](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/591)) - **Leaving a session keeps its draft:** a draft another client wrote (for example with `ghostex set-session-chat-draft`) is no longer wiped when you leave the session. ([#587](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/587)) - **Drop a session on the chat box to link it:** dragging a session row from the sidebar onto a chat box types its link at the caret, as Copy ID copies it, instead of splitting the pane. - **A tidier More actions menu:** the chat box's More actions lists the everyday actions first, then Agent (Rename, Sleep, Fork Session, Switch Account and more) and More. On the computer and the phone. - **A pasted picture whose path has spaces shows as a picture,** on the computer and the phone. - **Legacy models open under their row:** in the model picker, opening Legacy models lists them below it with no gap. On the computer and the phone. - **A message that could not be sent says so calmly:** a failed or waiting message gets a small card right under it with its icon, "Not sent" (or "Waiting to send", "Still not sent"), the reason in one sentence, and Retry and Terminal view as buttons, with Fix it, Start fresh, Edit and Remove in its ⋯ menu. Every notice card in the chat is calmer too, with only its icon in colour. On the computer and the phone.
### 📱 On the phone
- **The phone uses far less data:** long tool outputs come cut to what a card shows (the full text loads when you open it), the link to your computer is compressed, the sessions list is pushed as it changes instead of polled every 5 seconds, a chat picks up where it left off after a reconnect, and a hidden terminal tab sends nothing. - **Tabs switch instantly and can be dragged:** your last 4 chats stay ready, a held tab drags to a new place (the strip scrolls near its end), and on a tablet or an unfolded phone you can drop a tab on the right half to show two sessions side by side. - **See how each computer connects:** Settings > Connection lists every computer with its status and route (Tailscale, or Easy Connect through Private Relay, Global Relay, Direct or Same network), the Sessions screen stays quiet while everything works, and a computer added over Tailscale also pairs for Easy Connect and switches between the two by itself. - **Search Settings:** a search box at the top of Settings finds a setting on any page. - **Send logs to the developer:** Logs has Send to developer, with a review step that says what the report holds. - **The terminal view has a bottom bar** with the mode button and the chat box's other controls, on iPhone and Android. - **Spaces are icon tiles like the desktop's,** led by the Active projects star, and the work list shares one bar with the working status above the chat box. - **Show session names is on by default,** so alerts, the Live Activity and the widgets lead with the session's name. - **Android: the keyboard comes back** when you tap the chat box after closing it with the back gesture, and the chat box sits right above the keyboard instead of over an empty band. - **The questions sheet scrolls,** so every question and its buttons are reachable.
### 🪟 Windows
- **Claude starts on PCs that only have Windows PowerShell 5.1.** ([#582](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/582)) - **Web pages and the feedback form keep working after an update** when Windows will not let go of an old runtime folder. ([#581](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/581)) - **Emoji and characters like Hangul reach Windows apps whole,** long input is no longer cut, and repeated characters stay, thanks to @yossifyahya17-bit. - **A queued message stuck on an unreadable input box gets a repaint** and goes out, instead of waiting for the agent to reload. - **Autopilot recognises PowerShell and cmd deletes** (Remove-Item, del, erase, rd) and Windows paths when it checks for deletes outside the project, and an agent's refusal while its approval card is open logs as Waiting for you, not failed. ([#590](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/590))
### ⚡ Faster and lighter
- **Less GPU and memory use:** hidden menus, tooltips and popups no longer hold up to 64 MB of GPU memory each, the app gives back graphics memory after a heavy frame, and a chat hidden for five minutes keeps 1 MB of pictures instead of 8 MB. - **Big coordinators stay light:** a coordinator with over a thousand threads no longer rebuilds its work list and panel every 2 seconds, and Ghostex's server reads running sessions once instead of in every check.
### 🩹 Fixes and polish
- **Closing a page no longer crashes the Mac app** after the window it was last shown in went away. - **A file link in the chat of a session on another computer always opens:** it opens in Files in the window you clicked it in, or a toast says why it can't, instead of showing "Opening file in Files view" and then nothing. - **A session's computer icon sits in one column** down the sidebar, with its status and time lined up at the right. - **Copy ID is its own row** in a session's context menu, above Tag As, and a session from another computer names that computer in Copy ID, Copy Link and a drop on a chat box. On the computer and the phone. - **A session reference that names the wrong computer says where the session is** instead of saying the chat was closed. - **Notifications are simpler:** the panel has one ⋯ menu with Mark all read and Clear all (for every row), each notification shows its computer's icon, Next unread is gone (its hotkey stays), and a phone added for Easy Connect without a click can be removed from its row. On the computer and the phone. - **Ask Ghostex AI, Join Discord and Send Bug / Feedback are in the main menu,** below Keep Awake, instead of a Help submenu.

# Ghostex 11.5.0
## 11.5.0 - 2026-11-12
**Ghostex 11.5.0 is out.** Active projects from every Space and computer in one list, an icon for each computer, the whole sidebar arranged the same on all your computers, the Beads view, Fork from here, a crown for coordinators, queued messages that can no longer answer an approval, a phone app that matches the desktop's chat, and a lighter, faster app.
### 🧭 Sidebar
- **Active projects:** a star now leads the Spaces row. Click it to see, in one list, the projects you are working on from every Space and every connected computer (any project with a session working or waiting on you, or used in the last 8 hours), each with all its sessions, in your Spaces' order. Click a session to open it without switching Spaces; in the Unified sidebar the star shows only those projects' sessions. It is on by default: right-click the star to remove it, and turn it back on in Settings > Sidebar & Sessions > Spaces. - **An icon for each computer:** pick one for each of your computers (a laptop, a desktop, a server, a cloud, a house, a rocket and more) in Settings > Remote, under This computer for this one and in a saved computer's settings for the others. The icon is kept on that computer, so your phone and your other computers show the same one. While more than one computer is in the sidebar, every session shows its computer's icon in place of a short name like "WN", and the computers row beside the Spaces uses the same icons. Until you pick one, a laptop shows a laptop and other computers a desktop. - **Coordinators wear a crown:** a coordinator's row in both sidebars, its chat pills, its message cards, the `+` list, work chips, the coordinator tips, the Welcome page and the phone show a new outline crown instead of the captain's hat. A project's main coordinator wears it in gold instead of the "Main" tag. Chief of Staff and department leads keep their filled crown. - **The Unified sidebar shows a coordinator's threads as the Project sidebar does:** its threads hang under it in the same rows and tree lines, and its crown turns into the fold arrow when you point at it, on the computer and the phone, thanks to @sebastianarena.
### 🔄 Sync
- **Sync sidebar organization:** Settings > Sync's Spaces switch is now Sidebar organization, and it keeps the whole sidebar arranged the same on your computers and your phone: the order of your Spaces and the projects in each, project groups, Project or Unified sidebar, Separate by machine, the other settings that arrange the sidebar, and your Session Tags with their order. A change on one computer shows on the others within a minute without a restart, the newest change wins, and a project one computer doesn't have keeps its place until you add it there. Width, animations and card details stay per computer. Computers that had Spaces sync on keep it on. - **The view you pick for a chat follows you:** Quiet View or Full view, and the level of detail, picked for a chat on one device show on your other computers and your phone within seconds, and a chat opens in the view you picked last anywhere.
### 🧩 Beads
- **The Kanban view is now the Beads view:** it opens in the same place with the same hotkey, and a Tree | Board switch sits in its header. Tree shows every bead under its epic with the epic's progress, beads waiting on you pinned on top, filters for Ready, In progress, Blocked and Deferred, and a details pane to close, defer, reprioritize, comment and go to the agent on it. Board is the board you know, and its Columns dialog can now hide Backlog, Test and Review for every computer and agent on the project. The header shows when the beads last synced, with Pull and Push one click away; Push works with Beads 1.2 too, and in a narrow side panel the header's buttons move to a second line instead of past the edge (#573, #577), thanks to @sebastianarena.
### 💬 Chat
- **Fork from a message:** the ⋯ menu under one of your messages, or under the agent's last reply of a turn, now has Fork from here. It starts a new Claude Code session beside the old one whose conversation ends at that message, named "Fork: <old name>", so you can try another direction from an earlier point while the original keeps going. On the phone it is in the message's long-press menu. Other agents keep Fork Session, which copies the whole conversation. ([#362](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/362)) - **A queued message can no longer answer an approval:** when an agent asked for approval (or showed another prompt) at the very moment a message from the chat, its queue, an automation or Generate Name was going out, the message's Return could land in that prompt and approve it without anyone seeing it. Ghostex now reads the agent's screen right before typing the message and right before pressing Return, and does neither while a prompt shows; the message waits, is cleared from the agent's input box, and goes out once the prompt is answered. This covers Claude, OpenClaude, Codex, Grok, Empryo, Pi, Cursor, Copilot, Antigravity, Hermes, OMP and ZCode, the agents whose prompts Ghostex can see on screen. ([#555](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/555)) - **Every fold in the chat opens and shuts smoothly:** an opened Quiet View line, the answers it holds, a thought and Agent work Quiet's steps now ease open and shut over 200ms like the tool call cards, and each fold's arrow turns as it opens instead of jumping. The rest of the chat stays still while one moves, and nothing moves when your system asks for reduced motion. On the computer and the phone. - **Quiet View reads cleaner:** a line that is still working shows only its spinner, a finished line ("1 item updated", "Worked for 19s …") only its own icon, and a message to another agent counts once, as a message sent, not also as a tool call. In an opened line, tool calls sit in a card like the "Message to" card, whose whole header lights up under the pointer, and a click or tap anywhere on the thin line down an opened line folds it. On the computer and the phone. - **Opened work rows are easier to read and use:** in the work list docked above the chat box and in the Work panel, an opened row uses the whole card's width, leaves the same space between title, description and answers as a question card, and shows one small pill per work item (a dot for its state and its short id, such as #579 or W12; hover or long press for its name, click to open it) in place of the line naming it. Only a click on its title line shuts it, so you can select and copy its text, and a command in a description gets Copy and Paste in terminal buttons. On the computer and the phone. - **The work list leaves room for the conversation:** on the computer it never takes more than 40% of the window's height; on the phone it never takes more than 45% of the space above the chat box, folds to its one-line bar while you type so the chat box stays in view, and sits between the conversation and the "Working" line. - **A hidden Ghostex page waits above the chat box:** a page you put aside now shows as a pill in the row above the chat box, with its title and how many of its questions you answered ("3/16"), instead of a tab squeezed into the chat's header; click it to bring the page back. The phone's page sheet has Hide beside Close and shows the same pill. - **A question that reuses an old tag reaches you and the agent again:** when a coordinator asked a new question under a tag you had already answered, the question showed as answered and your click sent nothing. A tag reused for a different question now shows as a new, open question on the computer and the phone, and your answer reaches the agent; `ghostex coordinator next-tag` prints the next free tag, and `ghostex visual check` warns about a reused one. ([#579](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/579)) - **Claude's models are listed Fable, Opus, Sonnet, Haiku:** the model picker on the computer and the phone and the New Coordinator form list Claude's models by family, newest version first. A starred older model (Fable 5.1, for example) stays in Legacy models with its star lit instead of jumping to the top, a model moves into Legacy models on its own when a newer version comes out, and the Legacy models row always sits at the bottom of the list. The default model is still Opus 5.5. - **Rewind reaches messages above a compaction:** Rewind to here now works on messages from before a compaction Claude Code made while it ran, and says so when a message was compacted before Claude last started, instead of closing silently. - **Submenus in the chat's menus open on a click:** Snooze in a work row's ⋯ menu and every other submenu in the chat no longer opens on hover; a click opens it and keeps the menu open, and picking an item closes both. - **The /mcp menu's buttons stay where they are:** stepping through the servers with Previous and Next no longer moves them, on the computer and the phone. ([#576](https://github.com/maddada/Ghostex/issues/576))
### 📱 On the phone
- **The phone's sessions list is organized like your computer's sidebar:** it follows Sidebar organization sync, so Project or Unified, Separate by machine, Merge copies, Spaces, Active projects, Group working sessions, parking, Pinned order, the Moving section, Group by project and its project order, and your Session Tags list change on the phone when you change them on a computer, and its Settings > Sidebar & Sessions (or Sort & Filter in its ⋯ menu) changes them on your computers within seconds. With Separate by machine off, the phone's Project list is one list of every connected computer, a project on several computers is one entry with all their sessions, and the computer tabs show only while Separate by machine is on. Each project has the Working and Snoozed sections, the Tag As menu offers the tags you left on, Sort & Filter can show only sessions with a tag, and a long press on a Unified project group moves it up or down. A computer without Sidebar organization sync keeps what the phone had before. - **The phone's chat matches the desktop's:** a coordinator's chat opens in Quiet View, the work list above the chat box has the desktop's header, rows and Work sheet, #123 links to the project's GitHub issue or pull request, a hex colour gets its small swatch, and right-to-left text (Arabic, Hebrew) is right-aligned. - **Session details on the phone:** a ring at the end of the pills above the chat box opens the Session details sheet, with the desktop's Environment, Context, Tasks, Connectors, Skills, Memory files, Changes and Background tasks cards. - **Swipe between chats:** a quick sideways swipe on the conversation goes to the previous or next tab, and the chat's top bar now shows only the tabs, its ⋯ menu merged into the chat box's More actions. - **More from the chat box:** it says "Hold ↑ for options", and holding Send opens a menu that starts with Skills and commands, Mention a file and Add an agent. - **Notifications like the desktop's:** the Notifications screen lists the computer's notifications in Unread and Read, with Open Session, Mark as Read and Clear on each card, and Mark all read and Clear all at the top. - **The phone's sessions list follows your computers:** Active projects is a star chip first in the Space row (long press it to remove it, and the Unified list's filter offers it too), the computer tabs and sessions show each computer's icon, Sidebar organization sync arranges the list as on your computers, and each project has the desktop's Working and Snoozed sections. A computer running an older Ghostex keeps the cloud icon. - **Settings > Updates says what runs and what waits:** the app's version and where it came from, the update it runs now, and a newer one downloading or ready to restart into. - **A connection problem is one line above the search row** ("Can't reach MacBook · list from 2 min ago") instead of floating over the top rows. - **Android on Chromebooks and x86 emulators:** the Google Play app now carries x86_64 as well, so it runs natively there instead of crashing in the ARM translator.
### ⚡ Faster and lighter

## 11.2.2 - 2026-11-10
**Ghostex 11.2.2 is out.** Phones and Easy Connect computers stay connected through restarts and slow links, iPhone voice calls work even when the call microphone keeps stopping, Dictate never loses a recording, messages between agents fold into "Worked for", approvals work across your connected computers, and Android gets push notifications.
### 📱 On the phone
- **iPhones on 11.2.1 already have this release's phone fixes:** they arrived over the air, and the last ones come with this release's update. Per-computer Easy Connect keys and the full fix for the iPhone call microphone come with a later iPhone app; Android gets everything in this release's app. - **The phone is back right away after Ghostex restarts or updates on your computer:** over Easy Connect, the phone reconnects within a few seconds of Ghostex coming back, instead of showing "Reconnecting to …" for half a minute or more. - **The phone stays connected on a slow connection:** on weak cellular, or when Easy Connect or Tailscale goes the long way round, the phone no longer starts over while a chat, a long reply or a picture you're sending is still coming through, so nothing is lost, and a connection that really drops is still noticed and restored within seconds. - **A phone with two or more Easy Connect computers keeps them all connected:** once your phone app is updated, it connects to each computer with its own key, so connecting to one no longer stalls another for half a minute. Ghostex on your computers is ready for it now, and phones on the current app keep working as before. - **A phone on Tailscale or SSH asks each computer to pair once:** reopening the app or reconnecting waits on the same request instead of asking again, and one plain card says where to approve ("Approve this phone?" in Ghostex on that computer) and what waits meanwhile; it stays away for a computer that's asleep or that you hid. - **Android: push notifications reach the phone:** with this release's Android app, finished, waiting and error notifications arrive as push notifications. iPhones get them with a later iPhone app.
